name: Spider-Man (Miles Morales)

abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Spider-Man (Miles Morales) için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Whatever A Spider Can
Each time Miles completes a Spider-Challenge he gains a Passive Fury increasing Attack Rating by +[3,832.5 - 12,039.99] for 12 seconds.
Additionally, he may now complete Spider-Challenges multiple times during the fight instead of just once each. However, each Spider-Challenge can still only grant 1 Spider-Sense Charge.

abilitySections.title: Well Timed Blocks
content: While performing a Well-Timed Block, Miles will not attempt to utilize his personal Evade or Miss.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Challenges - Spider-Sense Charges
content: To learn to be a hero, Miles Morales has a list of Spider-Challenges he can complete each fight. Completing a Spider-Challenge grants an indefinite Spider-Sense Charge. Max Charges: 3.
Each Spider-Sense Charge grants a Passive 7% chance to Evade incoming attacks as well as +[1,095] Attack Rating.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Challenges - Once Per Fight Each
content: Block 15 attacks. Well-Timed Blocks count as 3 Attacks.
Land 50 attacks. Intercepting attacks count as 10 hits.
Avoid 10 attacks with Evade, Miss or the Dexterity Mastery. Special Attacks count as 2 hits each.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Camo
content: Each time the opponent launches a Special Attack, Miles' burgeoning abilities grant him a Spider-Camo Passive which is unaffected by Ability Accuracy and lasts 8 seconds.
Spider-Camo grants Attacks a 35% chance to Miss. This Miss chance is tripled against Unblockable attacks.
Spider-Camo also enhances Heavy and Special Attacks.
Once all Spider-Challenges are complete, Miles is In The Zone for the rest of the fight. While In The Zone, Spider-Camo will also activate each time Miles launches a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict a Taunt Debuff for 10 seconds which reduces Attack Rating by 30%.
Camo: 100% chance to inflict a Rupture Debuff, causing [10,950] Physical Damage over 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Last hit has a 100% chance to inflict a Weakness Debuff, reducing Attack Rating by 50% for 10 seconds.
Camo: Weakness gains +10 seconds duration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Final hit has a 100% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff causing [19,710] Energy Damage over 6 seconds.
Camo: This Shock gains +30% Potency for each personal Unique Debuff that has been activated on the opponent this fight.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% to inflict a Physical Vulnerability Debuff reducing Physical Resistance by [1,178.57] for 50 seconds.
Camo: 100% chance to also inflict a Power Sting Debuff lasting 50 seconds. An opponent with Power Sting takes [24,637.5] direct damage if they activate a Special Attack.

Additionally, he may now complete Spider-Challenges multiple times during the fight instead of just once each. However, each Spider-Challenge can still only grant 1 Spider-Sense Charge.
